build_ApproxMaxIoUAssigner: build an ApproxMaxIoUAssigner instance with pos_iou_thr and neg_iou_thr thresholds for bounding box assignment
create_assign_method: create a call to assign ground truth bboxes to approximated bboxes using max IoU per octave group
test_ApproxMaxIoUAssigner_assign: test the ApproxMaxIoUAssigner assign method with approxs, squares, and ground truth bounding boxes
review_IoU_thresholds: review the ApproxMaxIoUAssigner pos_iou_thr and neg_iou_thr configuration for positive and negative sample assignment
refactor_gpu_assign_thr: refactor the ApproxMaxIoUAssigner gpu_assign_thr to control when assignment falls back to CPU for large GT counts
